title: graphics.CheckerBoard draws its pattern with a texture generated on the fly, useTexture=True
author: Claude-JG
description: Maintainer 2026-10-18: graphics.CheckerBoard uses by default (useTexture=True) a 2x2 texture of its two colors, generated when it is called, on one quad of two triangles instead of 2 nTiles^2 triangles; useTexture=False keeps the triangles
releaseNotes: graphics.CheckerBoard is one quad with a texture of its two colors, generated when it is called (useTexture=True); useTexture=False gives the triangles of the pattern, e.g. for a contact mesh, and colors that encode a material give them as well (revision2026c step RG6.11.9)
